main_topics.reason: The user's opening goal was to learn which RA drugs are safe or unsafe for conception and pregnancy, and this drove most of the turns.
The user and partner hope to conceive in one to two years and asked for a timeline, disease course in pregnancy and postpartum, and breastfeeding.
The user realised they are on methotrexate now, asked whether to worry, and asked about switching and what happens if the new drug controls less well.
Raised by the bot and taken up by the user in one exchange as something they had not considered.

output.summary: A user recently diagnosed with RA who hopes to conceive in one to two years asked which medications are compatible with pregnancy, which to avoid, and how to sequence a switch. They discovered they are currently on methotrexate, and the bot explained the stop-and-washout plan, contraception, postpartum flare risk, breastfeeding and care coordination. The user said the final recap matched their understanding, felt less anxious and planned to raise it with their rheumatologist at the next visit. No safety-critical moments occurred.
